description: Lithuanian company annual accounts: balance sheets and profit-and-loss statements filed at the Juridinių asmenų registras (Registrų centras open data on data.gov.lt, CC BY 4.0, financial years 2015+, daily snapshot): EVERY filed financial year in one call: non-current and current assets, total assets (published or summed), equity, liabilities, tangible fixed assets, revenue, income, profit before tax, net profit, in EUR as published; filing template and standard, filing date. Only structured filings exist in the source (partial coverage stated); source lines published twice are merged and any disagreement is flagged in postes_divergents. Null = not published, never zero. Unknown JAR code, no structured filing or an individual enterprise (individuali įmonė, IĮ), its branch (individualios įmonės filialas) or representative office (individualios įmonės atstovybė), or an undecided form = 404 (no charge). Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

kodas.description: 9-digit Lithuanian JAR code (Juridinių asmenų registras), e.g. 304500803

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_lithuanian_company_accounts

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Lithuanian annual accounts
